Controls.Title: Fog Hex Editor
Controls.Hide: Hide cells (click or drag; hold Alt to reveal instead)
Controls.Reveal: Reveal cells (click or drag; hold Alt to hide instead)

EdgePadding.Name: Edge padding (fog pixels)
EdgePadding.Hint: Grows each painted cell slightly so no thin revealed rim is left along its edge. 0 = exact cell outline.

OverlayOpacity.Name: Preview darkness
OverlayOpacity.Hint: How dark unexplored areas look in the GM preview while the Fog Hex Editor tool is active.

OverlayColor.Name: Preview color
OverlayColor.Hint: Color used to show unexplored areas in the GM preview.

Targets.Title: Whose fog to edit
Targets.Hint: Edits apply to each chosen user's saved fog for the scene (and level) you are viewing. The preview shows everything any of them has explored.

Notify.Active: Fog Hex Editor: editing fog for {names}.
Notify.NoTargets: Fog Hex Editor: no users chosen. Use the users button to pick whose fog to edit.
Notify.Gridless: Fog Hex Editor needs a scene with a hex or square grid.
Notify.NoExploration: Fog exploration is turned off for this scene, so there is no saved fog to edit.
Notify.Busy: Fog Hex Editor is still saving the previous edit.
Notify.Done: Fog Hex Editor: {mode} {cells} cell(s) for {users} user(s).
Notify.Nothing: Fog Hex Editor: nothing to change (the chosen users have no saved fog here).
Notify.Failed: Fog Hex Editor: could not update {name}'s fog. See the console (F12) for details.
Notify.NothingToUndo: Fog Hex Editor: nothing to undo.
Notify.Undone: Fog Hex Editor: undid the last edit.
Notify.UndoOtherScene: Fog Hex Editor: the last edit was on another scene; view that scene to undo it.
